value.rationale: The result gives a complete exact evaluation of two newly unified metric invariants on a basic diameter-two family already prominent in general-position coloring. The sharp universal bound \(\gamma^3_2\le3\) for every noncomplete complete multipartite graph, together with its equality criterion, is structural rather than a routine numerical instance; the clique formula simultaneously identifies the associated geodesic-hypergraph clique structure.
